label: CV/Resume Screener
description: Screens candidate CVs/resumes against job requirements. Evaluates qualification match, experience relevance, career progression, and flags red/green signals. Produces ranked shortlist with assessment notes.

guidedInputs.label: Job requirements and competency criteria
guidedInputs.description: Paste the job description or list the key requirements: must-have qualifications, experience, technical skills, and competencies.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., Senior Compliance Manager — 7+ years in financial services compliance, AML/CFT expertise required, CAMS or equivalent preferred, experience managing a team of 5+, strong regulatory interaction experience (FCA/FSA), excellent written and verbal communication in English (Swedish preferred)...

guidedInputs.label: CV(s) to screen
guidedInputs.description: Paste one or more CVs. For multiple candidates, separate each with '---' and a candidate identifier (Candidate A, B, etc.).
guidedInputs.placeholder:
Paste CV text here. For multiple CVs use:
---
CANDIDATE A
[CV text]
---
CANDIDATE B
[CV text]

guidedInputs.label: Must-have criteria (dealbreakers)
guidedInputs.description: List any absolute requirements — candidates who do not meet these should be screened out regardless of other strengths.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., Must have AML/CFT compliance experience. Must be eligible to work in Sweden without visa sponsorship. Must have minimum 5 years financial services experience.

options.label: Red flags and areas for exploration
Ranked shortlist with summary assessment per candidate
Pass / Hold / Reject per candidate with rationale
